card.name: Quantity words before 'of' or units
card.fires_on: A quantity or fraction word right where 'of' or a unit would naturally come next, such as 'quarter' in 'quarter past', a number's unit (U, mg, mEq) or the denominator in a fraction like 1/2.

modes.label: Dose units after a number
modes.description: The unit piece directly after a numeric amount in dosing text.
modes.example: Administer Potassium Iodide Oral Solution or Strong Iodine Solution (e.g., Lugol's Solution) equivalent to 100<< mg>> iodide to block uptake of iodine

modes.label: Fraction denominators
modes.description: The bottom number of a written fraction such as 1/2 or 1/6.
modes.example: ​DIRECTIONS: ​Spray 9-12 pumps (approximately 1/<<2>> tsp.) directly in mouth 3 times

modes.label: Quarter or version nouns
modes.description: A noun like quarter or version that leads into a following phrase.
modes.example: It's barely a<< quarter>> past five in the morning.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word 'of' coming next, favoring other continuations such as the rest of a word or a unit.
card.plain: It marks a quantity word or unit in the middle of an amount, where the text will not go on with 'of'.
evidence: It's barely a<< quarter>> past five in the morning.
